title: Deployment Detected
message: order-service v2.1.4 deployed to production by ci-bot

title: Log Volume Anomaly
message: order-service log volume is 40x above baseline (48,000 lines/min vs 1,200 normal). Write rate jumped from 2.3 to 28.3 mbps.

title: Deploy Correlation Found
message: Log spike correlates with order-service v2.1.4 deployed 4 min ago. Config diff shows log.level changed to DEBUG.

message: /var/log at 86%. ETA full: 68 minutes. Root cause still active. Recommend: rollback order-service or change log.level immediately.

message: Auto-executed log rotation on /var/log. Freed 185 GB. Disk: 91% → 54%. NOTE: Root cause still active — this buys ~96 minutes only.

title: On-Call Paged — No Acknowledgement
message: carol@company.com (order-team primary) paged at 02:35. No acknowledgement after 5 minutes. Escalating to dave@company.com.

title: Rotation Ineffective — Root Cause Active
message: Log rotation did not resolve the issue. Write rate unchanged at 40 mbps. Re-projecting disk full by 03:42. Escalating to P1.

title: Secondary On-Call Paged
message: dave@company.com paged. No response from carol. Platform team (alice@company.com) also notified. Incident upgraded to P1.

title: DISK FULL — SERVICE CRASHED
message: CRITICAL: /var/log at 100%. order-service crashed — unable to write temp files. Immediate manual intervention required.

title: Cascade Failure — checkout-service 503
message: checkout-service returning 503. Depends on order-service (now crashed). Customer-facing impact confirmed.

title: On-Call Acknowledged
message: alice@company.com acknowledged incident. Beginning manual rollback of order-service to v2.1.3.

title: Incident Resolved
message: All services restored. order-service running v2.1.3. Disk at 40%. Total downtime: 103 minutes. Post-mortem scheduled.
